name: PPG Industries
description: PPG makes paints, coatings, adhesives and sealants and sells them in three ways: finished paint to contractors and consumers through its own stores, dealers and home centers outside the US (Global Architectural Coatings, 24% of 2025 sales); aerospace, auto-repair, marine and road-marking coatings sold mostly through distributors and directly (Performance Coatings, 35%); and factory-applied coatings sold directly to car, appliance and packaging makers (Industrial Coatings, 41%). It sold its US and Canadian architectural business and its silicas business in 2024, so its paint exposure is now mainly Latin America, Europe and Asia. Raw materials, mainly resins, pigments and solvents, are the main cost and are recovered through selling-price changes, some index-based in the industrial contracts.

businessLines.name: Global Architectural Coatings
businessLines.how: Paint sold per gallon to painting contractors and consumers through company-owned stores, home centers, dealers and distributors; repeat maintenance and repaint demand, tied to consumer sentiment and housing.
businessLines.description: Decorative paints, stains, adhesives and sealants in Latin America, Asia Pacific and EMEA (the US and Canada architectural business was divested in 2024).

operatingProfit.note: segment income as reported (before interest and taxes)

businessLines.name: Performance Coatings
businessLines.how: Specified products sold to aircraft makers and operators, body shops through distributors and to infrastructure owners; aftermarket replacement and maintenance demand repeats.
businessLines.description: Aerospace coatings, sealants and transparencies; automotive refinish; protective and marine coatings; Traffic Solutions (road marking).

businessLines.name: Industrial Coatings
businessLines.how: Direct-to-factory sales to car, appliance, equipment and can makers, often with on-site application services; volume follows customer production and prices follow raw-material indexes.
businessLines.description: Automotive OEM coatings, general industrial coatings, packaging coatings (can and closure coatings), and specialty products (TESLIN substrate, OLED materials, optical lens materials).
